# EPV findings this extension keeps on purpose, checked by the epv job in
# .github/workflows/tests.yml. One finding per line as EPV prints it, without
# "on line N", with paths relative to the extension; give the reason above it.

# ext.php reads phpBB's own serialized migration dependency lists when it moves
# an old nickvergessen/newspage install, with allowed_classes off, so no
# objects can be created.
Error: Using unserialize in /ext.php

# The post subject, poll question and edit reason are stored escaped. These
# calls escape them for the news page without escaping them twice
# (double_encode off), which utf8_htmlspecialchars() can't do.
Error: Using htmlspecialchars in /newspage.php
